stance_rationale: Primary covariance.parquet fails the RF-R2 post-shrink condition cap with cond=391.27 > 100, and the top20 covariance workaround is not a valid substitute unless optimizer universe is explicitly locked to that exact static basket. Tail/regime/crowding/PIT evidence is incomplete enough that this package cannot be admitted as a risk handoff.

sigma_audit.method_selected: primary covariance.parquet: lw_2003_const_cor + tikhonov_alpha_0.62; top20 artifact: lw_2003_const_cor_light_0.10

regime_sigma_audit.comment: Only top50 regime correlation was produced; no regime-conditional Sigma, pooled fallback, or bootstrap CI for CRISIS n=23.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: Incomplete: top20 overlap is 0/20 and style beta cor is 0.3637, but PG2 active-book HHI is absent and Q07 Quality family overlap remains under L-219 saturation risk.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: step1 comment says t-1 lag, but code sets end_date <- as_of_date; no vol_lag/dd_lag audit is included.
Regime labels are inherited from alpha artifacts, but risk package provides no FRED/KR-internals lag audit or switch-rate validation.
Factor returns use current sector/size mappings over the 60M covariance window; no PIT historical factor-return reconstruction audit is provided.

critical_concerns.description: Primary covariance.parquet is PSD but post-shrink cond=391.27, breaching the mandatory cond <=100 cap; top20 cond=84.80 cannot clear RF-R2 for an optimizer allowed to choose any <=20 names from the 336-name risk universe.

Tail risk is materially breached and underreported: step4_state shows monthly CVaR95=10.42% vs 2.5% cap and CVaR99=13.17%, while risk_package omits CVaR/CDaR/Hill alpha/EVT-GPD/VaR99/ES99 and no tail_risk.json exists.
CRISIS regime sample is n=23, below the RF-R8 n<30 threshold, with no bootstrap CI, pooled-Sigma fallback, or bounds-shrink instruction.

Published B, Omega, and D do not reconstruct the submitted covariance: recomputed BΩB'+D vs covariance.parquet has max_abs residual 0.0419 and relative Frobenius residual 1.77, so the package presents decomposition artifacts that are not the effective optimizer Sigma.

AX-001 v2 remains failed: alpha axis 3 bad/normal IC ratio is 0.79, axis 2 anti-correlation is false, yet risk language still claims TRUE diversifier/crisis_alpha without direct Core MDD relief evidence.

Crowding validation is narrower than claimed: TDC is reported, but HHI vs PG2 active book is missing, style correlation is only a 3-beta proxy, and Quality-family overlap is acknowledged but not resolved.

No Silent Override evidence is incomplete: risk_challenge_note.md, weights.csv, risk_package.json, optimization_package.json, and qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260502_001 artifacts are absent, so AX-008 triangulation cannot pass.
PIT proof is insufficient for risk: C9 vol/dd lag, C11 external-regime lag, and C12 factor-return PIT reconstruction are not auditable from the package and scripts.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores.parquet in stage_artifacts/WT_D20260502_001 has 63,506 rows across 184 sig_dates, so the Iter 4 single-snapshot alpha issue is resolved in dir B.
Primary covariance.parquet is symmetric and PD with min_eig=0.001828, so RF-R9 is not triggered.
Method shopping log contains 6 candidates and selection was not based on SR/IR return criteria.
Factor coverage R2=70.77% exceeds the 30% checklist threshold, but it is not tied to the final submitted Sigma because decomposition residual is large.
Top20 covariance_top20.parquet is PD with cond=84.80, but it is a scoped artifact, not a full-universe risk model.
unresolved_disputes: Whether optimizer is legally constrained to exactly the submitted top20 alpha tickers; if not, covariance_top20.parquet is not a valid RF-R2 mitigation.
Why the risk package relaxes full-Sigma conditioning to cn<400/500 when the role prompt requires cond <=100 post-shrink.
Whether CVaR95 breach should trigger infeasibility_report before optimizer handoff.
Whether current sector/size mappings over historical 60M returns satisfy PIT C12 in walk-forward use.
Whether STR_1715 TDC was measured against the actual PG2 active book or a static return proxy.
weakest_assumption: The package assumes a static top20 sub-Sigma can stand in for the primary 336-name covariance model and clear RF-R2, despite the final optimizer weights and selected names not yet existing.
rebuttal_required: Produce a primary covariance.parquet with cond <=100 post-shrink, or explicitly lock optimizer input to covariance_top20.parquet and the exact 20 tickers.
Export tail_risk.json with CVaR95/CDaR95/Hill alpha/EVT-GPD/VaR99/ES99 and file an infeasibility_report for CVaR95=10.42% if unchanged.
Provide CRISIS regime bootstrap CI or pooled-Sigma fallback for n=23.
Reconcile BΩB'+D to the final covariance or stop advertising the decomposition as the optimizer Sigma.
Add risk_challenge_note.md responding to alpha challenge items and restore requested qepm/stage_artifacts and weights.csv artifacts.
Provide code-level PIT audit for C9, C11, and C12.
rationalization_red_flags: Optimizer prefers covariance_top20.parquet for top-20 selection

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Claude surfaced several honest risk flags, but the package then routes around the hardest failures with a top20 covariance artifact and diversifier language. Codex cannot treat that as a completed risk package without primary Sigma, tail, regime, and governance repairs.

risk_specific_questions: If final optimizer can choose any <=20 names, how does covariance_top20.parquet protect subsets outside the static alpha top20?
Why is full Sigma cond=391 accepted when RF-R2 requires post-shrink cond <=100?
Where are the infeasibility_report, EVT/Hill alpha, CDaR, and bootstrap CI artifacts for CVaR95 breach and CRISIS n=23?
